summary: This 8-K/A amendment discloses amendments to a pre-existing convertible debt facility between Banzai International (the issuer) and CP BF Lending. The terms include a reduced conversion price (95% of stock price, floor $2.50), a commercially reasonable conversion obligation subject to a 5% daily volume limit, and a conditional $2M prepayment trigger. No new acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign is involved. The filing simply updates an earlier report with revised debt conversion mechanics and does not constitute a standalone special-situation event. It is a routine current report amendment regarding financing terms.
